queries.text: your objectives needs and goals we agreed the following

triggerProbe.absentWhen: No investment or pension objective is stated anywhere in the report.

queryGroups.requirement: Stated goals and their priority order

queries.text: we reviewed your needs objectives and time horizons and agreed the following
client objectives demands and needs recorded at the meeting priority order
what the client said they want to achieve in their own words discussion notes
most important priority ranked first second third objective

comparison.tolerance: Every objective in the report must be traceable to an evidenced objective; wording need not match.
falsePositiveGuards: Advisers paraphrase; judge on substance, not wording.
An objective present in evidence but omitted from the report is only a concern if the recommendation bears on it.

sufficiency.ifAssertionAbsent: Potential Concern: a suitability report with no stated objectives cannot demonstrate suitability.
sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern: objectives asserted with no fact find, file note or needs analysis recording them.

queryGroups.requirement: Retirement target date and investment time horizon details

queries.text: you want to retire in years time at age target retirement date
intended retirement age selected retirement age recorded on the fact find
investment term time horizon how long you wish to invest for years
when do you need to access this money planned date of withdrawal

comparison.tolerance: Report term and evidenced term must be reconcilable; a difference greater than 2 years is a mismatch.
falsePositiveGuards: A pension may have a long investment horizon while the income objective is short — distinguish the horizon of the money from the date of the goal.
Selected retirement age on a plan is a contractual default, not necessarily the client's intended date.

sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern where the risk profile or strategy is justified by a term that appears nowhere else.

queryGroups.requirement: Access requirements — emergency, planned and ad-hoc

queries.text: access to funds for emergencies planned spending and ad hoc withdrawals
do you have any planned expenditure or capital purchases in the next five years
emergency fund liquid capital available for unexpected costs

falsePositiveGuards: 'No access needs identified' is a valid evidenced answer; absence of an access need is not the same as failure to ask.

sufficiency.ifBothAbsent: Potential Concern: access requirements are named explicitly by this check and should have been established.

queries.text: expected changes in circumstances retirement inheritance income ceasing
spouse partner retiring income stopping state pension starting
any known future changes health care needs downsizing property

falsePositiveGuards: Legislative changes affecting everyone (e.g. pension IHT rules) are not client-specific foreseeable changes.

sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Note as a gap; escalate where a foreseeable change would materially alter the recommendation.

queries.text: competing objectives trade off between growth and income capital preservation
how the adviser resolved conflicting priorities with the client

falsePositiveGuards: Conflict is inferred, not stated — test structurally: two objectives claiming the same capital, or a growth horizon that outlasts a stated access date.

sufficiency.ifBothAbsent: No finding unless a structural conflict is visible in the retrieved objectives themselves.

queryGroups.requirement: Recommendations are appropriate for the stated goals given access needs, term and foreseeable changes

queries.text: my recommendation is suitable because it meets your objective of
when you can access the pension minimum pension age 55 57 restrictions on withdrawal
the recommendation will provide the income you need in retirement of per month

falsePositiveGuards: An objective linked by boilerplate ('this meets your objectives') is not a link — require a specific objective to be named.
Check the access mechanism, not the wrapper name: a pension for a 69-year-old carries no access restriction.

sufficiency.ifAssertionAbsent: Potential Concern: recommendations not tied to any stated objective.
sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Assess on the report alone; note that no needs analysis supports the linkage.

queryGroups.requirement: Goals, assumptions or planning requirements stated in the report that are not supported by the evidence

queries.text: you have told me that your objectives are and that you wish to
client objectives and needs recorded what the client wants to achieve
file note of the discussion about the client's aims and what matters most

falsePositiveGuards: An objective the adviser inferred and the client then confirmed at a meeting is stated, not unsupported — read the file notes before calling it unevidenced.
The report may summarise several recorded needs as one objective; the wording need not match, only the substance.
A planning assumption drawn from a provider illustration is evidenced by that illustration, not by the client.

sufficiency.ifAssertionAbsent: No issue on this requirement; nothing was asserted to verify.
sufficiency.ifEvidenceAbsent: Potential Concern: an objective the recommendation rests on has no source anywhere in the file.

decision.noIssue: Evidence complete, consistent and supports the outcome. Every objective in the report is evidenced in categories B, C or F; terms and access needs reconcile; and each recommendation names a specific objective it serves.
decision.potentialConcern: Material clarification or additional evidence required. An objective is asserted with no evidence, the stated term conflicts with the term used to justify the strategy, an access need is unaddressed, or recommendations are linked to objectives only by boilerplate.
decision.notApplicable: Not applicable — this check applies to all advised investment and pension cases.
severityHints: Highest: the recommendation cannot deliver a stated objective (locked capital against a known access date).
High: the investment term justifying the risk profile contradicts the stated goal horizon.
Moderate: objectives present but generic, with no evidence of client authorship.
Low: priority order not explicit where objectives do not compete.
decision.overlayInstruction: Vulnerability overlay: consider whether any actual or potential drivers or characteristics of vulnerability, support needs, communication requirements or reasonable adjustments identified in the evidence materially affect this check's assessment or the conclusions it reaches. Where they do, say so in the finding. A vulnerability recorded in the file that has no bearing on this requirement is not itself a concern here — CHK-010 assesses vulnerability in its own right.
